WITH incurred AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.claim_amount), 0) AS amt FROM claims c JOIN policies p ON c.policy_id = p.id JOIN products pr ON p.product_id = pr.id WHERE pr.product_code = 'product_001' AND c.claim_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND c.claim_date < DATE '2026-07-01' AND c.status IN ('settled', 'open')), earned AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.annual_premium * (LEAST(p.end_date, DATE '2026-07-01') - GREATEST(p.start_date, DATE '2026-04-01')) / 365.0), 0) AS amt FROM policies p JOIN products pr ON p.product_id = pr.id WHERE pr.product_code = 'product_001' AND p.start_date < DATE '2026-07-01' AND p.end_date > DATE '2026-04-01') SELECT incurred.amt / NULLIF(earned.amt, 0) AS ratio FROM incurred CROSS JOIN earned

WITH incurred AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.claim_amount), 0) AS incurred_amount FROM claims c JOIN policies p ON c.policy_id = p.id JOIN products pr ON p.product_id = pr.id WHERE pr.product_code = 'product_003' AND c.claim_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND c.claim_date < DATE '2026-07-01' AND c.status IN ('settled', 'open')), earned AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.annual_premium * (LEAST(p.end_date, DATE '2026-07-01') - GREATEST(p.start_date, DATE '2026-04-01')) / 365.0), 0) AS earned_premium FROM policies p JOIN products pr ON p.product_id = pr.id WHERE pr.product_code = 'product_003' AND p.start_date < DATE '2026-07-01' AND p.end_date > DATE '2026-04-01') SELECT incurred.incurred_amount / NULLIF(earned.earned_premium, 0) AS loss_ratio FROM incurred CROSS JOIN earned

  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(

      0,

    ) / 365.0
  ), 0) AS amt
  FROM policies p

  WHERE pr.product_code = 'product_007'
    AND p.start_date < DATE '2026-07-01'
    AND p.end_date > DATE '2026-04-01'
)
SELECT (SELECT amt FROM incurred) / NULLIF((SELECT amt FROM earned), 0) AS ratio

WITH incurred AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.claim_amount), 0) AS amt FROM claims c JOIN policies p ON c.policy_id = p.id JOIN products pr ON p.product_id = pr.id WHERE pr.product_code = 'product_008' AND c.claim_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND c.claim_date < DATE '2026-07-01' AND c.status IN ('open', 'settled')), earned AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.annual_premium * GREATEST(LEAST(p.end_date, DATE '2026-07-01') - GREATEST(p.start_date, DATE '2026-04-01'), 0) / 365.0), 0) AS amt FROM policies p JOIN products pr ON p.product_id = pr.id WHERE pr.product_code = 'product_008' AND p.start_date < DATE '2026-07-01' AND p.end_date > DATE '2026-04-01') SELECT (SELECT amt FROM incurred) / NULLIF((SELECT amt FROM earned), 0) AS loss_ratio

WITH q AS (SELECT DATE '2026-04-01' AS q_start, DATE '2026-07-01' AS q_end), incurred AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.claim_amount), 0) AS amt FROM claims c JOIN policies p ON p.id = c.policy_id JOIN products pr ON pr.id = p.product_id CROSS JOIN q WHERE pr.product_code = 'product_009' AND c.status IN ('open', 'settled') AND c.claim_date >= q.q_start AND c.claim_date < q.q_end), earned AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.annual_premium * ((LEAST(p.end_date, q.q_end) - GREATEST(p.start_date, q.q_start))::numeric / 365.0)), 0) AS amt FROM policies p JOIN products pr ON pr.id = p.product_id CROSS JOIN q WHERE pr.product_code = 'product_009' AND p.start_date < q.q_end AND p.end_date > q.q_start) SELECT incurred.amt / NULLIF(earned.amt, 0) AS loss_ratio FROM incurred CROSS JOIN earned

WITH q AS (SELECT DATE '2026-04-01' AS q_start, DATE '2026-07-01' AS q_end), prod_policies AS (SELECT p.id, p.annual_premium, p.start_date, p.end_date FROM policies p JOIN products pr ON pr.id = p.product_id WHERE pr.product_code = 'product_010'), incurred AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.claim_amount), 0) AS incurred_amount FROM claims c JOIN prod_policies pp ON pp.id = c.policy_id CROSS JOIN q WHERE c.claim_date >= q.q_start AND c.claim_date < q.q_end AND c.status IN ('settled', 'open')), earned AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pp.annual_premium * GREATEST(0, (LEAST(pp.end_date, q.q_end) - GREATEST(pp.start_date, q.q_start))) / 365.0), 0) AS earned_premium FROM prod_policies pp CROSS JOIN q WHERE pp.start_date < q.q_end AND pp.end_date > q.q_start) SELECT incurred.incurred_amount / NULLIF(earned.earned_premium, 0) AS loss_ratio FROM incurred CROSS JOIN earned
